summary.text: Richard Brown is a Republican state representative who currently represents Carroll 8 and is seeking re-election in the New Hampshire House of Representatives, Carroll 3, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Brown is a U.S. Army veteran and civil engineer.

paragraphs.text: Richard Brown served in the U.S. Army and earned a degree in civil engineering from Manhattan College.
His career experience includes working as an engineering technician, a construction engineer, a project engineer and a construction manager.
